title: 13. Term and Removal of Vice President

blocks.content:
• Term: 5 years
• Removal by resolution passed in Rajya Sabha and agreed by Lok Sabha.
Removal by resolution passed in Rajya Sabha and agreed by Lok Sabha.

items: The resolution for the removal of the Vice President can ONLY be introduced in the Rajya Sabha, unlike the President's impeachment which can start in either House.
Agreement of the Lok Sabha is mandatory following the resolution passed in the Rajya Sabha for successful removal.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Vice President is elected for a fixed term of 5 years.
The removal process can only be initiated by a resolution in the Rajya Sabha.
The resolution for removal must be agreed upon by the Lok Sabha to take effect.
